title: Susceptibiility

inlines.v: SUSCEPTIBIIL'ITY, noun [from susceptible.] The quality of admitting or receiving either something additional, or some change, affection or passion; as the susceptibility of color in a body; susceptibility of culture or refinement; susceptibility of love or desire, or of impressions.
